title: SMTP mail settings
intro: Configure the mail server connection here. After saving, open Mail and notifications to select this provider and send a test message.
recommendedDescription: Most providers support STARTTLS on port 587. Save host, account, and sender details here, then finish selection and testing in the mail center.
flowDescription: 1) Fill and save SMTP details on this page → 2) Open Mail and notifications and select the SMTP provider → 3) Send a test message and confirm the result in delivery history.

host.label: SMTP host
host.description: Hostname from your mail provider, for example smtp.gmail.com. Do not include http://.

encryption.label: Encryption
encryption.description: STARTTLS with port 587 is recommended. Use TLS/SSL with port 465 when required. None is only for trusted networks.

port.label: Port
port.description: Match encryption: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS/SSL, often 25 for none. Prefer 587 when unsure.

username.label: Username
username.description: Usually the full email address, not a display nickname.

password.label: Password / app password
password.description: Many providers require an app password, not the web login password. Leave blank to keep the saved secret.

from_address.label: From address
from_address.description: Visible sender address. Usually matches the account or a verified sending domain.

from_name.label: From name
from_name.description: Display name recipients see. The site name is recommended.

footerHint: Leave password blank to keep the saved secret. Restoring defaults also preserves secrets.
savedHint: If this provider is not selected yet under Mail and notifications, go back to choose it and send a test message.
